g.text: INSPECTION AND TEST PLAN, DESIGN CALCULATIONS
Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-304 Drum-top vibratory sifter (built in house) · rev B
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: INSPECTION AND TEST PLAN (record results here or in the MES)
Seat ring flatness after welding the upstand and skirt
Body: top flange flat 0.5, parallel to the ledge 0.5; shell round Ø480 ±1
Product-contact welds ground flush, no crevice at the ledge and bars (W3, W4)
Surface Ra on shell ID, ledge, deck rings, lid underside
Vibrator plate flat, holes per the maker drawing (4 x Ø11 on 120 x 70)
Deck: cloth taut (no drum sound dull spots), no tear, rings bonded/clamped all round
Dry fit: base on a real drum, body on isolators, gap to the upstand
Lid latched: pads squeeze the deck, lid does not move by hand
Inlet ferrule top to the blender valve outlet (sock length)
Insulation resistance motor + cord at 500 V DC
Isolator Q-306 OFF: aux opens first, DO_SifterVib drops (DI change on the HMI)
Bond: base to body through the strap; motor frame to PE
E-stop: KM-306 drops, vibrator stops; valve closes
Amplitude at the deck rim with a vibration sticker / meter
Startup / stop through resonance: no knocking of the body on the upstand
Sieve test: 1 batch, all product through, tailings on the deck recorded
Throughput with the valve at the set opening
Dust: no visible dust at the lid and band with the collector port open
Magnet pull test (keeper or 1 kg test piece) and catch log
ATP swab on the deck and shell after allergen wash
Valve interlock: valve cannot open with the vibrator off (MES/PLC)
Re-check vibrator bolts H3 after 1 h and monthly; isolators for cracks
Replace the screen cloth when torn or after 6 months
body + lid + deck 16.9 (CAD) + magnet, vibrator, latches, band
set the weights to this; vibrator not over-sized
< 4 mm gap to the upstand: OK
SF 2.8 even if all force were lift
26 mm under the valve for the sock
MS116-4.0 set to nameplate FLA, 14 AWG
